**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve LangChain compatibility for subscription clients**

When `WORKFLOWS_ANALYSIS_CLI` is enabled and subscription authentication is available, this shared factory returns a `SubscriptionClient`, which is neither a LangChain `Runnable` nor callable. Existing consumers such as `classify_capabilities` in `scripts/langchain/capability_check.py` and the issue optimizer compose the returned client with `ChatPromptTemplate` using `template | client`, so they raise `TypeError` before invoking the CLI. Scope this transport override to the auxiliary-analysis callers, or provide a Runnable-compatible adapter that also converts prompt values to the string expected by `SubscriptionClient.invoke`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

[P2] This marker is not bound to a particular closure or PR and is never cleared when an issue is reopened. If an issue is reopened after a handoff and later closed by a different PR, the old label makes this branch choose `done`, skipping verification of the new PR. Record and validate the source PR/closure identity, or clear the handoff marker on reopening before allowing another closure.

[P1] Adding the PR label does not guarantee that the verifier was triggered: an already-labeled PR produces no new `labeled` event, and events written with the fallback `GITHUB_TOKEN` do not start other workflows. Both cases still write this marker, so the next run reports verification as triggered even though no verifier ran. Dispatch the verifier with a triggering credential (or verify an existing run) before recording the handoff.

[P1] With `WORKFLOWS_ANALYSIS_CLI` enabled, this shared factory returns a client that is not a LangChain runnable, so callers such as `task_decomposer.py` and `capability_check.py` fail at `template | client` before invoking the CLI. The substitution also ignores requested provider/model overrides. Scope subscription routing to the auxiliary analyses, or supply a runnable adapter that converts prompt values to text and preserves caller selection contracts.

[P2] Filtering retired slots before `apply_slot_env_overrides()` shifts numbered overrides: if retired GitHub Models is first, `LANGCHAIN_SLOT1_MODEL` is applied to the next provider instead. Overrides can also reintroduce the retired selection, for example with `LANGCHAIN_SLOT1_PROVIDER=github-models` and `LANGCHAIN_SLOT1_MODEL=openai/gpt-5`. Preserve original slot positions and profile identities through override processing, then reject retired effective selections.

[P2] Closed issues with the legacy `verify:evaluate` label now enter `verify` instead of `done`, but a successful handoff has no automatic continuation. The redispatch allowlist excludes `verify`, and the event gate rejects `verify:pr-handoff` label events, leaving `agents:auto-pilot` in place without a completion report. Schedule a continuation after the handoff or complete the done disposition in the same run.

[P2] The search does not test for a match until after it has fetched every page, so a repository with at least 1,000 closed PRs makes ten sequential API requests even when the target is on page one. A rate-limit or API error on any later page also fails an otherwise successful lookup. Check each batch for the merged PR and stop as soon as it is found; retain the bound only for unsuccessful searches.

This retirement describes Muse as the replacement backup, but this consumer's create-only `config/llm_slots.json` has no `capacity_backup` block. `pr_verifier.capacity_backup()` therefore returns `None` even with `MUSE_API_KEY` set, leaving no configured replacement for a quota-exhausted judge. Configure and validate the consumer backup before relying on it, or explicitly document that this consumer has no backup.

[P2] Claude's credential check ignores `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, even though that variable is passed to the child CLI. When subscription credentials exist only in the configured directory, `available()` rejects the client before Claude can read them. Resolve the credentials file relative to the configured directory when present.

## Issue Optimization Suggestions

Review the suggestions below. If you want the agent to apply them, add the
`agents:apply-suggestions` label to this issue.

### Task splitting
- Fix `.github/workflows/agents-auto-pilot.yml` to dispatch the verifier with a triggering credential or verify an existing run before recording the handoff, and check each merged-PR search batch immediately, stopping on a match while retaining the bound for unsuccessful searches. (This task bundles two unrelated defects: P1 (handoff marker written without a verifier run) and P2 (merged-PR search fetches every page before matching). They involve different code paths and need different tests. The P1 clause also offers two alternative fixes ("or"), which leaves a design decision open. The sync-core process says one finding per issue, yet this issue carries two.). Suggested split: Fix the verifier handoff in agents-auto-pilot.yml so the handoff marker is written only after a verifier run is dispatched with a triggering credential or confirmed to exist., Fix the merged-PR search in agents-auto-pilot.yml to test each page of results for the target PR immediately and stop as soon as a match is found., Retain the existing page bound in the merged-PR search so that unsuccessful lookups still stop after the maximum number of pages., Add a regression test that fails when the handoff marker is recorded without a dispatched or existing verifier run., Add a regression test that fails when the merged-PR search requests more than one page after a page-one match..
- Add or extend regression tests beside `.github/workflows/agents-auto-pilot.yml` that fail on the reported behavior and pass after the fix. (This task covers two distinct behaviors (P1 and P2) and needs one test for each.
